test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On what basis is a joint said to be double-riveted lap joint or triple riveted lap joint?

options.text: Based on number of columns of rivets in joint
Based on number of rows of rivets in joint

solution:
The correct answer is __Based on number of rows of rivets in joint**(Option 4)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Double-riveted lap joint__ and __triple-riveted lap joint__ are distinguished based on the number of rows of rivets.
 
• In a double-riveted lap joint, there are two rows of rivets.
 
• In a triple-riveted lap joint, there are three rows of rivets.
 
• The strength of the joint increases as the number of rows of rivets increases.
 
• It is crucial for applications requiring higher strength and durability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lap Joint:**

 
 
• A lap joint is formed by overlapping two plates or sheets and riveting them together.
 
• It is commonly used in boilers and pressure vessels.
 
 
 
• **Rivets:**
 
 
• Rivets are permanent mechanical fasteners used to join two plates or sheets together.
 
• They provide high shear strength and are widely used in structural applications.
